display_name: The whole Sale of Food Act 1973 (Parts 1-7) under one top-level goal — for this article and what this person did with it, does the Act reach it, is an offence committed, does a defence answer it, and what is the most it can cost — and four goals: what the Act reaches, offences and penalties, defences and liability, enforcement and procedure
scope: Every provision of the Act as printed in SSO's informal consolidation of the version in force from 1 May 2026 (2020 Revised Edition). Inputs: the court's findings, the Director-General's and Minister's discretions, prescribed standards and compoundable offences, other Acts' classifications. Carried as text: powers and procedure listed in sfa-procedure.l4. NOT encoded: nothing in the Act.
